name: In Favor of the Light
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Hello again, young priest. The time has come for you to learn more about our religion. After you've completed whatever tasks you have here in Northshire, please seek out Priestess Josetta in Goldshire. She has more to teach you and has heard that you are growing strong in the ways of the Light. She looks forward to tutoring you more.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Priestess Josetta in Elwynn Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: I'm glad you've arrived, adventurer. We have much to discuss about your future and your path within the Light.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 4, 360 XP in all.
